doc: The adoption sidecar of M3 (holon.sorts.reextract; holon.diagram.linked): the holon-facts/0.3 documents holon extract wrote from the target at the pinned commit (step 1 of the blind rerun: the M2 and M3 extraction sidecars), every one adopted.
